bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json,sys
ps=subprocess.run(['docker','ps','--format','{{.Names}}'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
db=[s for s in ps.stdout.splitlines() if s.startswith('deploy-') and ('postgres' in s or s.endswith('-db-1'))]
assert len(db)==1
query="""SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)),'[]'::json) FROM (
 SELECT chat_id,message_thread_id,state,pinned,message_id,
  (token_hash IS NOT NULL) AS has_token
 FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE
  (chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1605)
  OR (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=4)) t;"""
p=subprocess.run(['docker','exec','-i',db[0],'sh','-lc','psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -A -t'],
 input=query,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
rows=json.loads(p.stdout.strip())
code=30
for i,chat in enumerate((-1002373696859,-1003770334893)):
 r=[z for z in rows if int(z['chat_id'])==chat]
 if len(r)>1:sys.exit(90)
 if not r:continue
 code+=1<<i
 if r[0]['state']=='published':code+=1<<(i+2)
 if r[0]['message_id'] is not None:code+=1<<(i+4)
 if r[0]['pinned'] is True:code+=1<<(i+6)
sys.exit(code)
PY
